The shared customer journey

  1. 01

    Find what needs attention

    Bounded public fetch → GEO v1 / SEO checks.

    Useful output
    Page evidence and product/service context.
    Before continuing
    Public reads never grant private analytics access.
    Open in the console ↗
  2. 02

    Understand your customers

    Shared product extraction → confirmed context → reviewed hypotheses.

    Useful output
    Source-labelled prompts saved explicitly by an administrator.
    Before continuing
    Tenant scope is checked on the primary page and its final redirect.
    Open in the console ↗
  3. 03

    Prepare the next improvement

    Use the relevant draft, approval and execution contract.

    Useful output
    Exact target/payload, durable review and adapter-specific outcome.
    Before continuing
    Apply Mode stops at preview. Social and GBP have separate execution paths.
    Open in the console ↗
  4. 04

    Measure what changes

    Normalise source observations into tenant-scoped module stores.

    Useful output
    Idempotent store ingestion and a durable commerce-to-CRM outbox.
    Before continuing
    CRM needs explicit enablement, module roles and exact scoped identity proof.
    Open in the console ↗
  5. 05

    Keep the team moving

    Expose curated reads, scoped reports and narrowly authorised workers.

    Useful output
    Traceable work with source/time, operational receipts and recovery states.
    Before continuing
    Installing the core does not activate Google consent, Postiz, Slack or client adapters.
    Open in the console ↗
Source

Three questions. Three kinds of evidence.

Planning content, reading results and following a contact complement each other. They do not describe the same data.

01 / Plan buyer content

What might the buyer ask?

Source
Observed product facts + confirmed buyer context
Useful output
Reviewed hypotheses

Not measured demand or a person’s history.

02 / Read business results

What did the source observe?

Source
GSC, GA4, saved AI answers or store signals
Useful output
Dated, scoped observations

Not proof of causality or a contact’s identity.

03 / Follow one contact

Which events belong to this record?

Source
Exact scoped identity links + authorised source events
Useful output
A clickable CRM timeline

Unmatched events stay unlinked. No inferred browsing history.

The existing stack, connected deliberately

Public evidence and authenticated client data use different entry points. Optional services are activated separately.

Connect only what the next decision needs

SourceRequired setupFirst verification
GA4 / GSC / GTMService account and exact resource permissionsRead a known period or container; compare against the source.
AI answersSourced import, or selected supported API accountConfirm source/date; explicitly approve any paid collection.
Shopify / PrestaShopStore scopes, encrypted credentials and sync/webhook setupCheck one order and a duplicate delivery before wider use.
CRMEnable collection, assign roles, prove exact identitiesReview linked and unlinked events, then pause/revocation behavior.
GBP / Social / SlackSeparate provider access, bindings and optional workersQualify the real source and approval/readback or audience boundary.

Your agent, your authorized workspace

The PAP 1.0 facade reuses five aggregate read models. Delegated signatures, OAuth grants, current Keycloak membership and resource consent are checked before returning data. Connected agents provides EN/FR consent and revocation.

Opt-in pilot, disabled by default: staging acceptance and testing of the actual agent are required. No publishing, purchases, new collection, general MCP access or CRM identity linking. Consent lasts at most 30 days and ends earlier on Keycloak logout or session expiry.

Review connected agents

What you can use, and what needs setup

These labels describe the product path. Your workspace permissions and successful source connections determine what you can actually read or execute.

Start freely

Public page analysis, grounded question hypotheses and the self-hosted software.

Connect deliberately

Analytics, stores, CRM, GBP and Social need their own setup. Slack is a separate optional service.

Preview or future scope

Apply Mode is preview-only; live GEO v2 rendering and named vendor CRM adapters remain future work. Gemini collection is disabled.

Self-hosted software is free under Apache-2.0. Solo €39/month and Agency €149/month are pilot hypotheses; checkout and subscription entitlements are inactive. Optional hosting and model/provider usage can incur costs.
